task_completion.description: Open the SeisComP configuration tool (scconfig) and navigate to the 'Bindings' tab.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'scconfig' window is visible with the 'Bindings' tab selected in the left-hand navigation or top menu.

task_completion.description: Create a new binding profile named 'broadband_opt' under the 'scautopick' module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new profile entry named 'broadband_opt' is visible under the 'scautopick' section in the bindings list.

task_completion.description: Set the 'filter' parameter to 'BW(3,0.7,4.0)' within the 'broadband_opt' profile.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'BW(3,0.7,4.0)' is typed into the 'filter' field in the configuration panel for the 'broadband_opt' profile.

task_completion.description: Set the 'timeCorrection' parameter to '-0.5' within the 'broadband_opt' profile.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The value '-0.5' is entered into the 'timeCorrection' field in the configuration panel for the 'broadband_opt' profile.

task_completion.description: Assign the 'broadband_opt' profile to the GE network stations (TOLI, GSI, KWP, SANI, BKB).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'broadband_opt' profile is dragged or assigned to the station nodes (TOLI, GSI, KWP, SANI, BKB) under the GE network in the bindings tree.
The 'Save' button is clicked, or a 'Configuration saved' confirmation message/status bar update is visible.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the scconfig GUI rather than just executing shell commands to modify config files directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the scconfig window, dropdowns, and text fields.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't simply run a pre-written script to automate the binding creation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen manually typing the profile name and values into the GUI fields.

integrity.description: Verify the agent is interacting with the GE network specifically and not a dummy network.
integrity.visual_evidence: The station list in the GUI shows the GE network prefix or the specific station names TOLI, GSI, KWP, SANI, and BKB.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create a profile named 'broadband_opt' specifically for the 'scautopick' module. The filter string must be exactly 'BW(3,0.7,4.0)' and the timeCorrection must be '-0.5'. These settings must be applied to five specific stations (TOLI, GSI, KWP, SANI, BKB) which belong to the GE network.
